battle.name: 德順軍之戰
battle.theater: 陝西鳳翔至寧夏德順軍
battle.brief: 金主完顏亮正隆六年分四道南下犯宋，西路軍副都統制張中彥率騎兵五千自鳳翔趨大散關。宣撫使吳璘夜襲寶雞渭河橋頭寨得手，收秦、隴、洮三州，兩軍在和尚原以猛火油火箭隔塹相拒。年底完顏亮兵敗采石被部將所殺；明年三月吳挺於瓦亭、吳璘於德順軍連敗金軍。和議在即，詔罷德順軍還軍河池。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的雙方是南宋與金朝。金方由海陵王完顏亮在正隆六年、也就是宋紹興三十一年的秋天傾國發動，分四路大舉南侵：西路軍副都統制張中彥率騎兵五千自鳳翔出發，攻下大散關後打算循棧道入蜀；中路由完顏亮自率大軍直趨兩淮；其餘兩路自山東、河南方向策應。金軍的指揮體系以行台、統軍司與都統府為骨幹，猛安謀克、漢軍與新附的漢人邊軍混編，攻城時仍倚重雲梯、撞車、飛石與投石機，騎兵則用於追擊、偵察與斷糧。宋方在川陝前線由四川宣撫司節制，宣撫使吳璘兼領秦鳳、涇原、熙河等路軍務，麾下是川軍主力，加上各路寨落、弓箭手與鄉兵，後方賴蜀道棧橋與關中屯田供給；同一時間淮東有魏勝義軍在采石一線與金軍周旋，兩線互相呼應。隆興元年宋孝宗即位，朝廷主和之議漸盛，川陝戰線的戰與和，遂由臨安的詔書決定。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Southern Song and the Jin dynasty. On the Jin side the war was launched in the autumn of the sixth year of Zhenglong (the thirty-first year of Shaoxing, 1161) by the Prince of Hailing, Wanyan Liang, who sent four columns south in one blow: the western column under Zhang Zhongyan, deputy commander-in-chief of the western army, marched out of Fengxiang with five thousand cavalry, took Dasan Pass and then planned to enter Sichuan by the plank road; the central column was led by Wanyan Liang himself straight down the two Huai; two further columns operated on the Shandong and Henan flanks. The Jin chain of command rested on the itinerant headquarters, the military administration offices and the commanderies, with meng'an mouke, Han troops and newly submitted Han border units brigaded together; for sieges they still relied on scaling ladders, battering rams, stone-throwers and trebuchets, while cavalry was used for pursuit, scouting and cutting supply lines. On the Song side the front in Shaanxi and Gansu was directed by the Sichuan pacification commission, with pacification commissioner Wu Lin holding concurrent authority over the circuits of Qin Feng, Jingyuan and Xihe; under him were the main body of the Sichuan army together with the garrison villages, crossbowmen and local levies of the circuits, supplied from the rear by the plank road across the Qinling passes and by the farms of the Guanzhong plain; at the same time Wei Sheng's volunteers were operating against the Jin on the Caishi reach of the lower Yangtze, so that the two fronts supported each other. When Emperor Xiaozong took the throne in the first year of Longxing the court's preference for a negotiated peace grew, and from then on whether the Shaanxi front would fight or stop was decided by an edict from Lin'an.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩朝。吳璘是這條戰線的宋方主帥，字信叔，陝西德順軍人，出身行伍，早年隨兄吳玠從軍；吳玠在和尚原、仙人關一線以地製敵、力拒金騎，開出川軍據險築寨、不與敵騎決戰平原的傳統，吳璘守關中數十年而不失一線，最為人稱道。吳璘的長子吳挺在1162年三月於瓦亭一役親率輕騎抄截金軍後路，是全役最漂亮的一擊；同月吳璘在德順軍再敗金軍。守將李彥堅在寶雞黃牛堡以寡制眾，擊退金軍騎兵的進攻。金方主帥張中彥是西路軍副都統制，率五千騎深入關中，兵驕而謀少，既未先取蜀口，也未料到宋軍已有備。完顏亮以帝王之身全軍南征，采石一敗即為自己的部將所殺；其從弟完顏雍被軍人推舉於燕京即位，是為金世宗，改元大定，收縮防禦。采石督軍的虞允文是扭轉全局的關鍵，他焚金軍浮橋而敗其全軍，直接解除了川陝戰線的牽制；宋孝宗趙昚即位後急欲革除積弊，卻被主和的湯思退一系所左右，最終詔令吳璘放棄德順軍。
peopleEn: The key figures span both courts. Wu Lin was the Song commander on this front. His courtesy name was Xinshu; he was a native of Deshun in Shaanxi, born into the ranks, and served early on under his elder brother Wu Jie, whose defence of Heshan Yuan and Xianreng Pass had established the Sichuan tradition of holding fortified ground and refusing to meet the enemy horse on open plain; Wu Lin held the line of Guanzhong for decades without losing a single post, and that was his chief title to fame. Wu Lin's eldest son Wu Ting, in the third month of 1162, led light cavalry at Wating to cut off the retreat of the Jin and scored the finest blow of the whole campaign; in the same month his father defeated the Jin again at Deshun. The garrison commander Li Yanjian held Huangniubao against the Jin horse near Baoji and threw back their attack with a handful of men. On the Jin side the commander was Zhang Zhongyan, deputy commander-in-chief of the western army, who carried five thousand cavalry deep into Guanzhong; his men were confident and his planning thin, for he neither seized the Sichuan mouth at once nor reckoned with a Song army already prepared. Wanyan Liang brought the whole realm south in person, and after his defeat at Caishi he was killed by his own officers; his kinsman Wanyan Yong was raised by the troops at the capital and became Emperor Shizong, opening the Dading era and pulling the armies back onto the defensive. Yu Yunwen, who supervised the defence at Caishi, was the man who turned the whole war, for burning the Jin floating bridge and destroying the whole army there, and that in turn freed the Shaanxi front from pressure. Emperor Xiaozong Zhao Shen came to the throne meaning to clear away old abuses, but was pulled aside by the party of Tang Situi, who favoured peace, and it was their view that ground thrust deep into enemy territory, hard to supply, could never be held, and that a treaty was better taken while the Jin was in disorder after the death of their ruler, that produced the edict ordering Wu Lin to abandon Deshun.
kits: 這張卡上的兵器是希臘火，但關中的營壘裡沒有拜占庭的銅管噴火器；它在這場戰爭裡的位置，是火攻技術的祖型，而真正落在此地戰場上的，是它的遠親——猛火油、火箭與火砲。希臘火以銅管或虹吸把混有石灰與瀝青的燃燒劑噴出，點燃後附著於船帆板木燒個不停；七百年代君士坦丁堡圍城戰中，阿拉伯艦隊被燒成火海。此後這套技術經西亞與印度洋航路傳入中國，宋代兵書所載的猛火油即是同一思路的中文表述：盛油於陶罐，以煙砲射向城垛與敵船，另配蘸油火箭。放到1161至1163年的關中，這套邏輯原封不動地重演：宋軍在寨牆後以火箭與火砲壓制逼近的金軍，燒其帳幕、糧車與攻城塔上的苫布；金軍在攻寨時同樣以火矢射宋軍的柵欄，燒其糧棚。除火攻外，川軍真正的骨幹是弩與步卒，神臂弓、臂弩與床弩一次齊射可壓住城頭與塹壕上的金兵，朴刀、長槍與密集步陣是近身格鬥的依賴；金軍則以輕騎射術、五千騎的機動打擊與硬弓見長，攻城序列配飛石、撞車、雲梯與皮簾大盾。物資方面，關中宋軍靠蜀道棧橋運糧、靠關中屯田與民夫輸轉；金軍草料多賴就地徵收，馬匹是川軍最缺之物。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is Greek fire, but there was no Byzantine bronze siphon in the camps of Guanzhong; its place in this war is as the ancestor of the technique of fire attack, and what actually fought on the ground here was its near relation, mineral oil, fire arrows and gunpowder artillery. Greek fire was made by forcing a burning mixture of lime and pitch out through a bronze pipe or siphon so that it stuck to sails and planking and kept burning; the most famous occasion was the siege of Constantinople in the seventh century, when the besieging Arab fleet was burned to a sheet of flame. From there the practice travelled to China along the routes of western Asia and the Indian Ocean, where the mineral oil of the Song military manuals is the same idea written in Chinese: oil kept in earthenware jars, fired at walls and enemy ships by a smoke bomb that shoots a burning jar, with oil-dipped fire arrows used alongside. Put into the Guanzhong of 1161 to 1163 the same logic was played out unchanged: the Song fired fire arrows and artillery from behind their palisades against the approaching Jin, burning their tents, their grain carts and the felt covers of their assault towers; the Jin in turn shot fire arrows at the Song stockades when storming a camp, burning their granaries. Apart from fire, the real backbone of the Sichuan army was the crossbow and the infantry: the shenbi bow, the hand crossbow and the bed crossbow could pin the enemy on a wall-head or in a ditch with a single massed volley, while the pole knife, the long spear and the close-order line were what the fight at contact came down to. The Jin were strongest in light cavalry archery, in the mobility of a force of five thousand horse, and in the strong bow, and their siege train carried stone-throwers, battering rams, scaling ladders and hide-covered mantlets. On the materiel side the Song drew their grain over the plank road and moved it by the farms of Guanzhong and by civilian labour; the Jin took their fodder largely on the spot, and horses were the one thing the Sichuan army most lacked.
tactics: 吳璘在關中的戰法可以用不動兩字概括：他不追求在野戰中擊潰金騎，而是在大散關、和尚原、秦州一線依山築寨，以塹壕、鹿角、拒馬與柵牆把騎兵擋在寨外，再用弩陣與火箭在對方貼近時射其人馬器物；寨與寨之間互為犄角，使金軍必須逐點攻取。金軍的進攻倚重人數與器械，先以騎兵掩護驅散宋軍斥候，再以撞車填壕、飛石與投石機壓制城頭，最後扛雲梯蟻附；吳璘偶爾也出奇制勝，1161年九月之後派兵夜襲寶雞渭河橋頭寨成功，切斷金軍在渭河一線的聯繫；1162年三月吳挺在瓦亭抓住金軍騎兵在狹窄山道無法展開的弱點，以輕兵截其歸路，一戰而勝。金軍全線潰退之後，宋軍一度反攻陝、商、虢、華諸州，但那已是攻勢的尾巴。真正的敗因出在撤退：隆興元年正月詔令放棄德順軍、還軍河池，宋軍撤退未及整飭，後衛與輜重脫節，金軍乘勢追擊，於山谷之中殲滅大量人馬，傷亡三萬餘人。兩相比較，吳璘守時無懈可擊，撤退時卻缺乏遮蔽與殿戰的安排，這是他一生最大的敗筆。
tacticsEn: Wu Lin's way of fighting in Guanzhong can be summed up in two words: he did not move. He did not seek to break the Jin horse in open battle, but raised camps along Dasan Pass, Heshan Yuan and Qin Prefecture, relying on mountains, ditches, abatis, caltrops and palisades to hold the horse outside, and then used the crossbow line and fire arrows against men, horses and siege gear once the enemy came close; the camps stood in a system of mutual support, so the Jin had to take them one at a time. The Jin assault in turn rested on numbers and machines: cavalry first, screening the Song outposts, then battering rams dragged into the ditches, stone-throwers and trebuchets beating down the wall-heads, and finally scaling ladders carried up under cover. Wu Lin was also capable of the surprise: after September 1161 he sent troops to attack the bridge-head camp on the Wei River at Baoji by night and succeeded, cutting the Jin communications along the river; in the third month of 1162 Wu Ting at Wating caught the Jin horse in a narrow mountain track where it could not deploy, and cut its retreat, winning the action. After the general Jin collapse the Song drove back at the Jin garrisons of Shan, Guo and Hua, but that was the tail of the offensive. The real defeat came with the withdrawal: in the first month of Longxing the edict ordered Deshun abandoned and the army back to Hechi, the retreat was not reorganised, the rearguard and the baggage train came apart, and the Jin followed them up, catching the Song in the mountain gullies and destroying a great part of the force, with more than thirty thousand men lost. Set the two sides against each other, Wu Lin was unassailable while he held and had no cover or plan for a fighting rearguard when he gave way, and that is the greatest blot on his record.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾個節點上。戰役自1161年九月金帝分四路大舉南侵起，至1163年正月宋孝宗詔令罷兵止，前後約十六個月，跨正隆六年、紹興三十一年、隆興元年三個年號。張中彥率騎兵五千自鳳翔出發，是雙方唯一有明確記載的編制數字。1161年年底金主完顏亮在采石大敗並被部將所殺，金軍全線潰退，吳璘乘勢反攻鞏、陝、商、虢、華五處金軍駐地。1162年三月，吳挺於瓦亭敗金軍，吳璘於德順軍再敗金軍；四五月間宋軍收復環、蘭、會、熙、鞏等州，連同此前收復的秦、隴、洮，合計十三州之地。1163年正月宋軍撤退時傷亡三萬餘人，十三州重歸金朝。距離上，鳳翔、寶雞、大散關同在渭河河谷東西百里之間，關中與德順軍之間的秦隴山道則是數百里棧道，運輸全賴人力畜力。
dataEn: The checkable figures cluster around a few landmarks. The campaign ran from September 1161, when the Jin ruler launched his four columns south, to the first month of 1163, when Emperor Xiaozong ordered the fighting stopped, about sixteen months in all, across three era names: Zhenglong six, Shaoxing thirty-one and Longxing one. Zhang Zhongyan's five thousand cavalry out of Fengxiang is the only order of battle that is clearly recorded on either side. At the end of 1161 Wanyan Liang was beaten at Caishi and killed by his own officers, the whole Jin line collapsed, and Wu Lin pressed the counter-offensive against the Jin garrisons at Gong, Shan, Guo and Hua. In the third month of 1162 Wu Ting defeated the Jin at Wating and his father defeated them again at Deshun; between the fourth and fifth months the Song recovered Huan, Lan, Hui, Xi and Gong, which together with Qin, Long and Tao taken earlier made thirteen prefectures. In the first month of 1163 the Song lost more than thirty thousand men in the withdrawal and the thirteen prefectures went back to the Jin. In distance, Fengxiang, Baoji and Dasan Pass all lie within a hundred li east and west along the valley of the Wei, while the Qin and Long mountain track between Guanzhong and Deshun is several hundred li of plank road carried entirely on human and animal power.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接起因，是完顏亮正隆六年的滅宋之舉。金朝自完顏亮遷都燕京、推行漢制之後，把滅宋定為國策，分四路大舉南侵，川陝一路的目標是取下蜀口：關中與蜀道是南宋西北的屏障與糧道，佔據陝蜀可截斷宋廷的西翼，也可為兩淮主攻解除側翼威脅。宋廷在秦鳳、涇原、熙河一線倚賴吳璘的川軍守關，吳璘憑和尚原、仙人關的經驗，堅持據險築寨、避免與金騎野戰，使金軍速戰速決的計畫在關中一再落空。1161年冬采石的大敗是轉折點：海陵王死，軍心潰散，金朝全線收縮，川陝的進攻目標從攻宋變成守關；此時宋廷在淮東、淮南也因金主南征而空虛，正需喘息。隆興元年宋孝宗即位，起用新進，急於革除積弊；但主和的湯思退一系主導朝議，認為關中深入敵後、運糧不繼，所得十三州終非久據之地，不如趁金朝新亂之際換得和議。於是詔令吳璘放棄德順軍、還軍河池，川陝戰線就此收束。
causeEn: The immediate occasion for this war was Wanyan Liang's plan to destroy the Song in the sixth year of Zhenglong. After moving the capital to Yanjing and pushing Han institutions, the Jin court made the destruction of Song national policy and the war was fought out in four columns; the object of the Shaanxi column was the Sichuan mouth, for Guanzhong and the Shu roads were the Song's northwestern screen and supply line, and holding Shaanxi and Sichuan would cut off the court's western flank and relieve the two Huai of pressure from the side. The Song relied on Wu Lin's Sichuan army to hold Qin Feng, Jingyuan and Xihe, and Wu Lin, following the lesson of Heshan Yuan and Xianreng Pass, insisted on fortified positions and refused to be drawn into a cavalry battle on open ground, so the Jin plan of a quick decision failed again and again in Guanzhong. The defeat at Caishi in the winter of 1161 was the turning point: the Prince of Hailing died, the army lost heart and the Jin withdrew everywhere, and the object on the Shaanxi front changed from conquering Song to holding the passes. The Song court at the same time had its hands free in the east, for the Jin ruler's campaign had stripped the lower Yangtze, and it needed to breathe. When Xiaozong came to the throne in the first year of Longxing he wanted to clear away accumulated abuses, but the peace party led by Tang Situi dominated the council: ground pushed deep behind enemy lines, hard to provision, could never be held for long, and it was better to take a treaty while the Jin were disordered. Hence the edict that Wu Lin abandon Deshun and return to Hechi, and the Shaanxi front was shut.
impact: 德順軍之戰的直接影響，是南宋在關中的經營以十三州易回而告終，宋軍退回河池與大散關內線，關中、涇原一線重回金朝版圖，隆興和議隨即以淮水為界、銀絹歲貢各二十五萬的條款收尾，宋金邊界維持到十三世紀初蒙古南下才被徹底打破。就戰術層面而言，這場戰爭把宋軍憑城壘以當騎兵的守禦術推到成熟：塹壕、拒馬、寨柵、弩陣與火箭的組合，讓重裝騎兵無從施展；而金軍靠騎兵、撞車、飛石強攻的樣本，也說明野戰失利之後的強攻能造成多大消耗。技術上，希臘火所代表的燃燒劑技術譜系，經西亞傳入中國後在此役以猛火油、火箭的形式再次出現在塹壕與寨牆之間，是火攻從海戰走向野戰的一次可見的移植。對後世而言，關中與蜀口在蒙古征服時代再度成為必爭之地，吳璘奠定的川軍守關傳統由其子吳挺一系延續，說明這套戰法在對抗高速機動的北方騎兵時，仍是南方政權可行的選項。
impactEn: The direct effect of the Deshun war was that the Song's work in Guanzhong ended with the thirteen prefectures given back and nothing gained; the army withdrew behind Hechi and the inner line of Dasan Pass, Guanzhong and the Jingyuan road went back to the Jin, and the Longxing settlement then closed the affair with the Huai as the frontier and twenty-five thousand in silver and silk paid yearly, a border that held until the Mongol advance in the early thirteenth century broke it for good. At the level of tactics the war carried the Song method of holding behind works against horse to its maturity: the ditch, the caltrop line, the stockade, the crossbow line and the fire arrow together did everything that heavy cavalry could not do; and the Jin sample of pressing on with horse, rams and stone-throwers showed how much a failed pursuit in the field could cost in a frontal assault. In technology the burning-agent lineage that Greek fire represents, having come to China through western Asia, appeared once more between ditch and palisade in this war in the form of mineral oil and fire arrows, a visible transfer of fire attack from sea battle to land battle. For later ages, Guanzhong and the Shu roads became once more the ground that had to be fought for in the age of the Mongol conquests, and the tradition of the Sichuan army holding the passes that Wu Lin established was carried on by his son Wu Ting's line, showing that against the fast-moving cavalry of the north this method remained a workable choice for a southern state.
result: 就宋軍而言，1161年九月到1162年五月是一段完整的上升期：收復大散關與秦、隴、洮三州，趁金軍全線潰退之際反攻鞏、陝、商、虢、華，再於1162年三月於瓦亭、德順軍兩戰重創追兵，四五月間盡收環、蘭、會、熙、鞏，關中一度盡入宋手。就金軍而言，完顏亮的西路是整場南征中最先崩壞的一環：五千騎深入關中，攻黃牛堡不成、夜襲渭河橋頭寨失利，攻勢在和尚原與寶雞一線僵持，終因采石潰敗而全軍瓦解。真正的結局出在隆興元年正月：宋孝宗詔令吳璘放棄德順軍、還軍河池，宋軍撤退途中遭金軍追擊，傷亡三萬餘人，奮戰所得十三州之地盡歸金朝，川陝戰線退回秦鳳以內。換言之，這是一場在戰術上由宋軍完勝、在戰略上由宋廷自我放棄的戰爭：前線將領用兵有方，後方決策卻以和議為先，最終以得城而復失收場。
resultEn: As far as the Song was concerned, from September 1161 to May 1162 was a complete rising phase: Dasan Pass and the three prefectures of Qin, Long and Tao recovered; the counter-stroke into the Jin garrisons of Gong, Shan, Guo and Hua once the whole Jin line collapsed; two heavy blows given to the pursuing force at Wating and Deshun in the third month of 1162; and by the fourth and fifth months Huan, Lan, Hui, Xi and Gong taken, so that Guanzhong for a moment was wholly in Song hands. As far as the Jin were concerned, the western column was the first part of the whole southern campaign to break: five thousand horse went deep into Guanzhong, the attack on Huangniubao failed, the night stroke on the bridge-head camp on the Wei failed, the offensive jammed on the Heshan Yuan and Baoji line and came apart entirely after the defeat at Caishi. The real ending came in the first month of Longxing: Xiaozong's edict sent Wu Lin back from Deshun to Hechi, the Song were overtaken in the withdrawal and lost more than thirty thousand men, the thirteen prefectures so painfully won went back to the Jin, and the Shaanxi front contracted inside Qin Feng. In short this was a war the Song won outright in tactics and gave away in strategy: the commanders on the front fought well, the decision at the rear put the treaty first, and the campaign closed with cities taken and then given back.
